name: Community Food Processing Centre
benefit: - **Training:** The Community Food Processing Centre provides training in fruit and vegetable processing for 10 days in urban areas and 15 days in rural areas. - **Food Processing:** The Community Food Processing Centre facilitates community-based food processing activities.
_eligibility_text: ***Training:*** - Any individual or farmer from Uttarakhand can receive training at the Community Food Processing Centre. A fee of ₹15/- is charged per trainee for the training. ***Food Processing:*** - Food products can be prepared at the Community Food Processing Centre by providing the required raw materials. A fee of ₹15/- per kilogram is charged for processing.
